## Kyoto Family Trip at a Gentle Pace

A 3-day plan built for **2 adults + 1 child (age 8)** with **easy walking**, **temples**, **kid-friendly meals**, and **sightseeing blocks kept under 2 hours**.
Budget target: **¥120,000 total excluding hotel**; this plan is designed to stay comfortably inside that limit with public transit and casual dining.

## 3-Day Kyoto Itinerary: Temples, Short Walks, and Family Meals

| Day | Morning | Lunch | Afternoon | Dinner | Transport |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 2 | **Kiyomizu-dera** early visit; 90 min on gentle slopes | **Soba / udon near Higashiyama** | **Sannenzaka + Yasaka Shrine**; 60–90 min, slow stroll | **Kaiseki-lite or set meal in Gion** | Bus + short taxi if needed |
| Oct 3 | **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove + Tenryu-ji**; 90–120 min | **Yudofu or tofu set lunch** | **Monkey Park Iwatayama** or **river walk**; choose one, 60–90 min | **Okonomiyaki / teppan** near central Kyoto | Train to Arashiyama, walk, optional taxi |
| Oct 4 | **Nijo Castle** or **To-ji Temple**; 90–120 min | **Onigiri / curry / family diner** | **Nishiki Market area** for snacks + souvenir time; 60–90 min | **Station-area dinner before departure** | Subway / JR / walk |

## Day-by-Day Family Pace Plan

### Day 1: Higashiyama Temple Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Start at **Kiyomizu-dera** as early as possible to avoid crowds and heat; keep the visit to the main grounds and viewpoint.
- **Transport:** Take a city bus or taxi to the lower approach, then walk uphill slowly; use a taxi for the return if the child gets tired.
- **Lunch:** Simple **soba, udon, or tempura set** near Higashiyama.
- **Afternoon:** Walk **Sannenzaka** and **Ninenzaka**, then visit **Yasaka Shrine** for a calm final stop.
- **Dinner:** Choose a relaxed **Gion set meal** with rice, grilled fish or chicken, miso soup, and a child-friendly option like tamago or curry rice.

### Day 2: Arashiyama Nature and Temple Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Go to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** early, then continue to **Tenryu-ji**; keep the garden visit short and unhurried.
- **Transport:** Use the **JR Sagano Line** or **Hankyu + bus** depending on where you stay; this is the easiest area for a family day without long transfers.
- **Lunch:** A **tofu/yudofu set** is a Kyoto specialty and usually easy for kids to share with rice and soup.
- **Afternoon:** Pick **one**: **Monkey Park Iwatayama** if your child likes animals and a mild uphill walk, or a **river walk + bridge area** if you want a flatter pace.
- **Dinner:** Try **okonomiyaki** or a **teppan grill** spot; it is usually more kid-friendly than a formal dinner and works well after an active day.

### Day 3: Castle, Market, and Easy Finish
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **Nijo Castle** for a different Kyoto highlight with low walking intensity; if you prefer a temple focus, swap in **To-ji Temple** instead.
- **Transport:** Use the **subway or JR** for the shortest, simplest ride; this keeps the day easy and predictable.
- **Lunch:** Keep it casual with **onigiri, curry rice, or a family restaurant** near the next stop.
- **Afternoon:** Spend the final block around **Nishiki Market** for snacks, sweets, and souvenirs; it is easy to shorten if the child gets tired.
- **Dinner:** Have an early meal near **Kyoto Station** so departure logistics stay simple.

## Budget Plan for 3 People

| Category | Planned Spend | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Local transport | **¥9,000–¥15,000** | City buses, subway, JR, and 1–2 taxis as needed |
| Admission fees | **¥6,000–¥12,000** | Temples/castle/optional monkey park |
| Lunches | **¥12,000–¥18,000** | Casual noodles, tofu sets, family meals |
| Dinners | **¥18,000–¥30,000** | Relaxed sit-down meals, mostly mid-range |
| Snacks / drinks | **¥4,000–¥8,000** | Market snacks, tea, ice cream |
| Buffer | **¥15,000–¥20,000** | Extra taxi, souvenirs, or weather changes |
| Total estimate | **¥64,000–¥103,000** | Leaves room under your ¥120,000 cap |
